ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status), IF( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'On Hold'), AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Activated')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Cancelled')) ), IF( ISPICKVAL(Status,'On Hold'), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Draft'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Complete information'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Sent for signature'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Payment Process'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'In Approval Process'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Finalized'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Discontinued'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Payment Rejection'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status),'Cancelled') ), false ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only change Contract status from On Hold to Activated or Cancelled, or from Activated to On Hold.
